consequence.statement: Unless allowFirstLastIPs is set explicitly, the first and last IP addresses of the pool become available for allocation.
consequence.remediation: If you rely on the previous behavior, set allowFirstLastIPs: no in the IP pool before upgrading.

assertion.statement: The default of CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.allowFirstLastIPs changed to "yes", so the first and last IPs of a pool become allocatable unless configured otherwise.
